name: Pacing Threshold Boundary (1600ms Guessing)
technicalRootCause: EGEA relies on a crisp cutoff (1500ms). Latency of 1600ms evades detection, resulting in CONTEXTUAL_HINT.

name: Touch Jitter / Double-Tap Artifact (< 200ms)
technicalRootCause: EGEA lacks an ultra-low latency debounce filter (< 250ms). It interprets accidental touch jitter as impulsive guessing and triggers STEPWISE_SLOWDOWN.

name: Variant Step Identifier for Identical Problem
technicalRootCause: EGEA performs exact string matching on stepIdentifier. Variant suffixes prevent persistent impasse detection, falling through to CONTEXTUAL_HINT.

name: Maladaptive Hint-Reliance on Correct Steps
technicalRootCause: EGEA correctly checks that hintExposureCount did not change during the streak. Because hints were consumed, it does NOT falsely fade scaffolds.

name: Transient Error After 10-Step Mastery Streak
technicalRootCause: EGEA treats the mistake as an isolated conceptual error rather than jumping to severe remediation.

name: Floundering Across Steps (3 Errors on 3 Distinct Steps)
technicalRootCause: Because errors occur on different steps, EGEA does not falsely trigger WORKED_EXAMPLE. Because total errors = 3 (< 4), it does not falsely trigger PREREQUISITE_REVIEW.
